name: @elizaos/voice-standalone
description: Standalone node/bun deployment of the REAL Phase-1 realtime + ambient voice-session backend (mint consent+JWT chain -> attachVoiceWsHandler -> VoiceSession/AmbientSession -> merged Deepgram Flux / Cartesia Sonic adapters), as a long-running HTTP + WS service bound to 127.0.0.1 so nginx can front /api/v1/voice/session/** for the in-browser sol-dev voice test. Auth-gated by a shared secret (dev/test deployment; see standalone-server.ts for the honest CF-worker-vs-standalone auth/tenancy boundary). NOT a second production voice implementation — it mounts the same real route logic the CF worker mounts.
